title: Install Tip or A-Axis Cable (A-axis PCA to cable carrier/grommet and sensor/valve M8 connectors)
summary: Replace/install the Tip or A-Axis cable by routing it correctly around the gearbox and into the cable carrier, securing it, routing all required M8 connectors through the grommet, connecting the labeled Valve/tote detect/LONG/SHORT gripper sensors, installing the valve cover without pinching wires, reinstalling side panels if needed, and restarting the operator station.
when_to_use: Use when the Tip or A-Axis cable needs replacement/installation and you must ensure correct cable routing, grommet use, labeled M8 connector connections (Valve, tote detect, LONG/SHORT gripper sensors), valve cover installation without pinching wires, and a successful operator station restart.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform the physical installation steps (routing, securing, connector installation, valve cover and side panel reassembly) and restart the operator station.
safety_notes: The source references LOTO in the surrounding Tip or A-Axis cable section (7.3.15.1 REMOVAL) and includes PPE/tooling context for the Tip or A-Axis cable work.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the A-axis PCA, gearbox area, cable carrier, cross bars, grommet, valve, tote detect sensor, LONG/SHORT gripper sensors, and valve cover

access_required: Physical access to the tipper/operator station area containing the A-axis PCA, gearbox, cable carrier, grommet, sensors, and valve cover
system_preconditions: Tipper/operator station is in a safe state for maintenance work (source context references LOTO for this cable procedure section)
external_references: Starting The Operator Station (referenced by the source as the restart procedure on page 66)

visual_references.description: Installation diagram for the Tip or A-Axis cable showing cable routing around the gearbox into the cable carrier and through the grommet with M8 connector labeling context.

steps.title: Plug new cable into A-axis PCA and route around gearbox into cable carrier
steps.purpose: Establish correct electrical connection at the A-axis PCA and ensure the cable follows the required routing path around the gearbox and into the cable carrier.
steps.instruction: Plug the new Tip or A-Axis cable into the A-axis PCA, then route the cable around the gearbox and into and around the cable carrier.
steps.expected_result: The cable is plugged into the A-axis PCA and physically routed around the gearbox and into/around the cable carrier along the intended path.
steps.healthy_condition: Cable routing matches the installation diagram: cable passes around the gearbox and into/around the cable carrier without being misrouted.
steps.failure_condition: Cable is routed incorrectly around the gearbox/cable carrier or not properly seated at the A-axis PCA.

actions.label: Verify PCA plug-in and routing path
actions.exact_action: Plug the new cable into the A-axis PCA and route the cable around the gearbox and into and around the cable carrier.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 1: Plug the new cable into the A-axis PCA and route the cable around the gearbox and into and around the cable carrier.

steps.title: Close cross bars with dividers between cable and air line
steps.purpose: Prevent cable/air-line interference by ensuring the cable is separated from the air line using the dividers when the cross bars are closed.
steps.instruction: Close all the cross bars, ensuring the dividers are positioned between the cable and the air line.
steps.expected_result: All cross bars are closed and the dividers are between the cable and the air line.
steps.healthy_condition: Dividers visibly separate the cable from the air line within the cross-bar assembly.
steps.failure_condition: Dividers are not positioned between the cable and air line.

actions.label: Close cross bars and position dividers
actions.exact_action: Close all the cross bars, ensuring the dividers are between the cable and air line.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check wiring/routing if the dividers are not positioned between the cable and air line.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 2: Close all the cross bars, ensuring the dividers are between the cable and air line.

steps.title: Align cable markings and wire-tie in place (both cable carrier ends and A-axis carriage tie point)
steps.purpose: Secure the cable in the correct position using the same alignment and tie points as before.
steps.instruction: Align the cable markings to the cable carrier and wire-tie in place as before, including both ends of the cable carrier and the tie point on the A-axis carriage.
steps.expected_result: Cable markings align to the cable carrier and wire ties secure both ends of the cable carrier and the tie point on the A-axis carriage.
steps.healthy_condition: Cable remains in the intended position with ties at both cable carrier ends and the A-axis carriage tie point.
steps.failure_condition: Cable markings are misaligned or ties are missing/incorrect at the specified tie points.

actions.label: Align markings and secure with wire ties
actions.exact_action: Align the cable markings to the cable carrier and wire tie in place as before, including both ends of the cable carrier and the tie point on the A-axis carriage.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 3: Align the cable markings to the cable carrier and wire tie in place as before, including both ends of the cable carrier and the tie point on the A-axis carriage.

steps.title: Ensure no dangling wires near A-axis PCA; contain with wire ties
steps.purpose: Reduce risk of interference or damage by ensuring the area near the A-axis PCA is tidy and secured.
steps.instruction: Near the A-axis PCA, ensure no wires are dangling; use wire ties as needed to contain the cable.
steps.expected_result: No dangling wires are present near the A-axis PCA; cable is contained/secured with wire ties as needed.
steps.healthy_condition: Wires near the A-axis PCA are restrained and do not hang freely.
steps.failure_condition: Any wires are dangling near the A-axis PCA.

actions.label: Check for dangling wires and secure
actions.exact_action: Near the A-axis PCA, ensure no wires are dangling. Use wire ties as needed to contain the cable.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check wiring/routing if any wires are dangling near the A-axis PCA.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 4: Near the A-axis PCA, ensure no wires are dangling. Use wire ties as needed to contain the cable.

steps.title: Route all four M8 connectors through grommet and push jacketed cable end through
steps.purpose: Ensure strain relief and correct cable pass-through by routing connectors and jacket through the grommet.
steps.instruction: Route all four M8 connectors through the grommet one at a time, then finish by pushing the end of the jacketed cable through the grommet.
steps.expected_result: All four M8 connectors are routed through the grommet and the jacketed cable end is pushed through the grommet.
steps.healthy_condition: Connectors pass through the grommet without being forced or misrouted; jacketed cable end is seated through the grommet.
steps.failure_condition: Any M8 connector is not routed through the grommet or the jacketed cable end is not pushed through.

actions.label: Pass connectors and jacket through grommet
actions.exact_action: Route all four M8 connectors though the grommet one at a time and finish by pushing the end of the jacketed cable through the grommet.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 5: Route all four M8 connectors though the grommet one at a time and finish by pushing the end of the jacketed cable through the grommet.

steps.title: Connect 3-pin M8 connector labeled "Valve" to the valve
steps.purpose: Restore the valve sensor/actuator connection using the correctly labeled M8 connector.
steps.instruction: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "Valve" to the valve.
steps.expected_result: The 3-pin M8 connector labeled "Valve" is connected to the valve.
steps.healthy_condition: Valve connector is fully seated and matches the label "Valve".
steps.failure_condition: Valve connector is not connected or is connected to the wrong target.

actions.label: Connect Valve M8
actions.exact_action: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "Valve" to the valve.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 6: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "Valve" to the valve.

steps.title: Connect 4-pin M8 connector to tote detect sensor
steps.purpose: Restore tote detect sensing by connecting the correctly labeled 4-pin M8 connector to the tote detect sensor.
steps.instruction: Connect the 4-pin M8 connector to the tote detect sensor.
steps.expected_result: The 4-pin M8 connector is connected to the tote detect sensor.
steps.healthy_condition: Tote detect connector is fully seated at the tote detect sensor.
steps.failure_condition: Tote detect connector is not connected or is connected incorrectly.

actions.label: Connect tote detect M8
actions.exact_action: Connect the 4-pin M8 connector to the tote detect sensor.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 7: Connect the 4-pin M8 connector to the tote detect sensor.

steps.title: Connect 3-pin M8 connector labeled "LONG" to longer gripper sensor
steps.purpose: Restore the longer gripper sensor connection using the correctly labeled connector.
steps.instruction: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "LONG" to the longer gripper sensor.
steps.expected_result: The 3-pin M8 connector labeled "LONG" is connected to the longer gripper sensor.
steps.healthy_condition: LONG connector is fully seated at the longer gripper sensor.
steps.failure_condition: LONG connector is not connected or is connected to the wrong gripper sensor.

actions.label: Connect LONG gripper M8
actions.exact_action: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "LONG" to the longer gripper sensor.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 8: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "LONG" to the longer gripper sensor.

steps.title: Connect 3-pin M8 connector labeled "SHORT" to shorter gripper sensor
steps.purpose: Restore the shorter gripper sensor connection using the correctly labeled connector.
steps.instruction: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "SHORT" to the shorter gripper sensor.
steps.expected_result: The 3-pin M8 connector labeled "SHORT" is connected to the shorter gripper sensor.
steps.healthy_condition: SHORT connector is fully seated at the shorter gripper sensor.
steps.failure_condition: SHORT connector is not connected or is connected to the wrong gripper sensor.

actions.label: Connect SHORT gripper M8
actions.exact_action: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "SHORT" to the shorter gripper sensor.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 9: Connect the 3-pin M8 connector labeled "SHORT" to the shorter gripper sensor.

steps.title: Install valve cover with M4x50 screws; avoid pinching wires; seat grommet into tote sensor wire notch
steps.purpose: Reassemble the valve cover while preventing wire damage and ensuring the grommet is seated correctly for the tote sensor wire.
steps.instruction: Install the valve cover using the four M4x50 socket-head screws. Make sure not to pinch any wires along the edges of the cover, and insert the grommet into the notch for the tote sensor wire.
steps.expected_result: Valve cover is installed with four M4x50 socket-head screws; no wires are pinched along the cover edges; grommet is inserted into the notch for the tote sensor wire.
steps.healthy_condition: Cover edges do not trap wires; grommet sits in the tote sensor wire notch.
steps.failure_condition: Wires appear pinched at the valve cover edges or grommet is not seated into the tote sensor wire notch.

actions.label: Install valve cover and seat grommet
actions.exact_action: Install the valve cover using the four M4x50 socket-head screws. Make sure to not pinch any wires along the edges of the cover, and insert the grommet into the notch for the tote sensor wire.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and re-check wiring/routing if wires appear pinched at the valve cover edges.
Stop and re-check wiring/routing if the grommet is not seated into the notch for the tote sensor wire.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 10: Install the valve cover using the four M4x50 socket-head screws. Make sure to not pinch any wires along the edges of the cover, and insert the grommet into the notch for the tote sensor wire.

steps.title: Reinstall top and/or bottom side panels if necessary
steps.purpose: Restore station enclosure panels after completing cable installation and valve cover reassembly.
steps.instruction: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.
steps.expected_result: Top and/or bottom side panels are reinstalled as required for the station configuration.
steps.healthy_condition: Panels are back in place (no open access panels left if they were removed).
steps.failure_condition: Side panels remain removed when they were required to be reinstalled.

actions.label: Reinstall side panels
actions.exact_action: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 11: Reinstall the top and/or bottom side panels, if necessary.

steps.title: Restart operator station
steps.purpose: Bring the operator station back online after physical reassembly so the system can resume normal operation.
steps.instruction: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).
steps.expected_result: Operator station restarts successfully after reassembly.
steps.healthy_condition: Operator station is running after restart attempt.
steps.failure_condition: Operator station does not restart successfully.

actions.label: Restart operator station
actions.exact_action: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

stop_or_escalate_if: If the operator station does not restart successfully, escalate using the site’s standard support process.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Section 7.3.15.2 INSTALLATION step 12: Re-start the operator station (see "Starting The Operator Station" on page 66).

success_criteria: Cross bars are closed with dividers positioned between the cable and air line
Cable markings are aligned to the cable carrier and the cable is wire-tied at both cable carrier ends and the A-axis carriage tie point
No dangling wires are present near the A-axis PCA
All four M8 connectors are routed through the grommet and connected to the labeled targets: Valve, tote detect sensor, LONG gripper sensor, SHORT gripper sensor
Valve cover is installed with four M4x50 socket-head screws without pinching wires along cover edges
Grommet is inserted into the notch for the tote sensor wire
Side panels are reinstalled if necessary
healthy_conditions: Dividers are between the cable and air line after closing cross bars
Cable markings align to the cable carrier and wire ties secure the specified tie points
No dangling wires near the A-axis PCA
Grommet is seated into the notch for the tote sensor wire
Valve cover edges do not pinch wires
failure_conditions: Any wires are dangling near the A-axis PCA
Dividers are not positioned between the cable and air line
Grommet is not seated into the notch for the tote sensor wire
Wires appear pinched at the valve cover edges
Operator station does not restart successfully
escalation_guidance: If the operator station does not restart successfully, escalate using the site’s standard support process (the source does not provide additional troubleshooting steps).
